comments.author: viramjain99
comments.body:
If search and all filters are disabled while the API is in a loading state, it’s acceptable not to pass the signal, since the user cannot trigger additional requests.

However, if users are allowed to change filters, search terms, or pagination while a request is in progress, then we should pass the signal to properly cancel the previous request and prevent race conditions or stale data issues.
